referenceFidelity.findings: Broad oak deck boards, industrial rails and an open timber pavilion use the researched GitHub rooftop terrace vocabulary. Furniture is separate; pergola footprint and complete deck layout are authored.

construction.findings: Deck slab and all intersecting wood boards are cut around the fixed stair interface X[11.1,14.1],Z[-5.5,1.25]. Guards follow the two sides and bottom edge while the upper landing stays open. Small intermediate oak step keeps roof access rises under .3 m.

readability.findings: At phone width the perimeter, pergola and rectangular stair aperture are visible. Large usable deck intentionally leaves space for the separate concrete seating/planters.

motion.findings: Deliberately static environment architecture, no skeleton or authored clips.

secondPass.findings: Reviewed current top, rear, isometric and phone after cutting the roof aperture. Top view confirms no floor backing in the stairwell; side/bottom guards and open arrival edge form a coherent access point.
